description: Read-only; no parameters. Returns the service's Telegram integration status as JSON: telegram_bot_running, telegram_token_configured, last_heartbeat, uptime_started, messages_sent, active_users, commands_processed, vip_invites_sent, and the full wallet state. Authoritative for wallet state, and for whether this service's monitoring is alive: check the heartbeat before trusting other outputs.
name: get_bot_status
